units.text: The WHO estimated 214 million new malaria cases worldwide in 2015 according to the World Malaria Report 2015.

judgement.reason: The passages support the estimate of 214 million new malaria cases worldwide in 2015 and the World Malaria Report 2015 title, but they do not explicitly attribute the estimate to the WHO.

units.text: A later WHO report from 2025 states there were 230 million new malaria cases in 2015, reflecting possible retrospective revision of data.

judgement.reason: The 2025 WHO passage states 230 million new malaria cases in 2015, but it does not state or imply that this reflects a retrospective revision of earlier data.
